name: Swachh Bharat Mission
benefit: ₹12,000 for toilet construction (rural), community toilets and waste management (urban), ODF status
benefit_hindi: Shauchalay banwane ke liye ₹12,000 ki madad (gaon mein), sheher mein samudayik shauchalay

eligibility.description: Rural households without toilets (Gramin) and urban areas for sanitation infrastructure
eligibility.description_hindi: Gaon ke woh ghar jinmein shauchalay nahi hai, aur sheher mein safai ki suvidha
criteria: Rural household without a toilet (for individual household latrine)
Urban: municipalities for community and public toilets
exclusions: Households that already have a functional toilet

documents_required: Photo of construction site (before and after)

steps: Contact Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office
Apply for Individual Household Latrine (IHHL) subsidy
Take photo before and after construction
₹12,000 subsidy credited to bank account after verification
steps_hindi: Gram Panchayat ya Block Development Office se sampark karein
Shauchalay ke liye subsidy ka application dein
Banwane se pehle aur baad ki photo lein
Jaanch ke baad ₹12,000 bank account mein aayenge

hindi_summary: Swachh Bharat Mission mein gaon mein shauchalay banwane ke liye 12000 rupaye ki madad milti hai. Gram Panchayat mein application dein — subsidy bank account mein aayegi. Helpline 1800-180-0404.
